Gravação de Sessão Privilegiada

The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

Questions and answers

What is Gravação de Sessão Privilegiada?

In this glossary, Gravação de Sessão Privilegiada refers to: The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

How is Gravação de Sessão Privilegiada used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Habilite a gravação de sessão privilegiada em todos os servidores de produção para garantir uma trilha de auditoria completa das ações de root e admin."

Definition

The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

Operational example

Enable privileged session recording on all production servers to ensure a complete audit trail of root and admin actions.
